scenarios.task: Set curtainwall units on the coastal-facing entry of the new Charter Hall visitor wing while wind picks up off the Pacific.
hazards: pinch points between units and frame
steps: Attend JHA briefing and confirm wind speed limit with foreman
Inspect rigging and suction cups for salt corrosion
Tag lines onto panel before the lift
Guide unit into opening, keep hands clear of pinch points
Shim, plumb and temporarily fasten per drawing
Signal crane for release and secure loose materials

rubric.pass_if: Checks all rigging and suction devices and rejects any corroded gear
Keeps panel under control and never positions self downwind of load
Hands remain visible and clear of pinch points at all times
No loose shim stock or tools left on slab edge

scenarios.task: Pull branch circuit conduit and wire for sequencing-server racks inside the Research Synthesis Lab fit-out.
steps: Lock out and tag out the affected panel
Verify zero energy with meter
Hang EMT rack to layout lines above rack rows
Make grounding bushings and bond every run
Pull conductors with proper lubricant and caps
Megger test circuits and label panel directory

rubric.pass_if: Applies lock, tag, and verifies zero energy before work
All runs bonded and megger readings within spec
Racks level, bends within code bend radius
Panel directory fully labeled after testing

scenarios.robot_role: Feeds wire off spools and holds conduit steady overhead while electrician makes connections.

scenarios.task: Tie in a new chilled-water branch feeding lab cooling units without shutting down the main loop.
steps: Confirm hot work permit and fire watch
Isolate, drain and verify branch line dead
Tack weld outlet fitting and cool per WPS
Full weld, inspect, and pressure test at 1.5x
Re-insulate and remove fire watch only after cooldown

rubric.pass_if: Hot work permit signed and fire watch posted before arc strikes
Line verified drained and dead before cutting
Pass visual inspection and holds test pressure
Permit closed and area cleared after cooldown

scenarios.task: Place and finish an exposed-aggregate patio at the Proposal Forum outdoor debate area.
steps: Set screed rails to grade from benchmark
Pour and spread with rakes, watch for rebar chairs
Screed and float surface
Broadcast and embed aggregate
Wash surface at correct set time to expose aggregate
Cure and cover, rope off area

rubric.pass_if: Finished surface within 1/4 inch of spec grade
Keeps wet concrete off skin, wears full PPE
Aggregate exposed evenly, no over-washing
Area barricaded during cure

scenarios.task: Swap a rooftop packaged unit serving the Operations Deck crane-coordination room on a windy coastal roof.
steps: Establish warning line and anchor points at roof edge
Kill and LOTO unit disconnect, verify dead
Recover refrigerant into recovery cylinder before line cut
Disconnect electrical, gas and condensate, drop old unit by crane
Set new unit, reconnect and leak-test brazed joints
Evacuate system, charge by nameplate, start up and verify

rubric.pass_if: Tied off or inside warning line 100% of time at edge
Recovers all charge, no venting, logs quantities
LOTO and verified before disconnecting
Leak test passed, superheat and airflow within spec

scenarios.task: Rig and signal the crane pick of a steel canopy truss over the Progress Observatory viewing deck as onshore wind rises.
steps: Calculate weight and center of gravity, select rigging with 5:1 factor
Inspect slings and shackles, reject damaged gear
Attach tag lines before lift
Confirm exclusion zone cleared of all workers
Give standard hand signals; guide truss to connection points
Land, bolt and release only on signal person confirmation

rubric.pass_if: Rigging rated and configuration matches load chart
No personnel under load at any point
Uses standard signals and crane operator acknowledges each
Stops pick when wind exceeds site limit

scenarios.robot_role: Carries tag line and streams ground-level video so signaler can see blind side of pick.

scenarios.task: Plant native Torrey pine and coastal scrub and install erosion-control matting on the bluff trail below the Progress Observatory.
steps: Inspect trail edge and flag no-go zone within 10 feet of bluff
Stage plants and matting with cart, not carry loads
Install biodegradeable coir matting and stake on contour
Plant natives per plan, water in
Remove invasives and haul out debris

rubric.pass_if: Never crosses flagged bluff-edge line without fall protection
Matting staked on contour, no gaps
Species and spacing match landscape plan
Trail and staging area left clean

scenarios.task: Characterize and safely remove abandoned chemical drums found during lab utility trenching.
ppe: Level B or C suit per reading
face shield or SCBA per air monitoring
steps: Stop work and isolate the area 75 feet upwind
Air monitor for VOCs, oxygen and LEL before approach
Inspect labels and drum condition, never move leaking drums
Overpack and manifest per DOT and state rules
Document for disposal and decontaminate personnel leaving zone

rubric.pass_if: Stops work, isolates and notifies supervisor before approaching
Air readings taken and documented before entry
No drum moved until characterized and overpacked
Full personnel and equipment decon before leaving exclusion zone

scenarios.robot_role: Tows air-monitoring sensors and cameras into the exclusion zone to characterize drums before human entry.
